recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is; no FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7410 unless the work group revises the compatibility policy later.
issue_request: FHIR-7410 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core compatibility clarification asking to explicitly allow deprecation for value sets with enumerated code lists and fixed bindings, despite the rule that codes are not removed.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 6441. Git-svn commit ec96d36d2491452da31833cd64bb6790e590e32c (#7410 - note about deprecation) added the deprecation note to source/compatibility.html with the typo "thought they may be deprecated"; later commit 45f9ade1d944b68093cbb5eac54f9bb06df85b30 corrected it to "though," and d68b8964af6bcba886df7c89465a68e18951f5fd moved the compatibility content into source/versions.html.
additional_context: source/versions.html is a current published top-level page listed in publish.ini. The current bullet says fixed enumerated value sets may have codes introduced and will never have codes removed, "though they may be deprecated." FHIR-10135 is the same sentence's later typo correction and was audited opportunistically.
reconciliation: No source change was needed because the current build-scope source already contains the requested deprecation allowance with corrected wording.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the typo introduced when the FHIR-7410 text was initially applied.
